plugins.name: meetstream
plugins.description: Build meeting intelligence with the MeetStream API: AI notetakers, real-time sales coaches, conversation intelligence, Google Calendar auto-recording, and AI meeting agents. Scaffolds complete apps in one prompt. Works with Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams, including signed-in bots. Every endpoint live-tested, no hallucinations.

skills.name: calendar-automation
skills.description: Build Google Calendar-driven meeting automation on MeetStream - connect a Google Calendar once and a bot auto-joins every upcoming meeting, records, transcribes, and triggers your post-meeting workflow. Use when the user says "auto-record my Google Calendar meetings", "connect Google Calendar to MeetStream", "Google Calendar bot integration", "calendar automation for meetings", "join every meeting on my calendar automatically", "scheduled meeting bot", "recurring meeting notetaker", "Google Calendar meeting intelligence", or "OAuth calendar bot setup". Walks through Google Cloud OAuth setup, connects the calendar to MeetStream, enables auto-scheduling with a default bot config, and shows how to handle recurring events.
headings: Step 2: Google Cloud OAuth setup (one-time, walk user through)
Step 3: Connect the calendar to MeetStream
How auto-scheduling actually works (live behavior, not just docs)
skills.description_zh: 在MeetStream构建Google Calendar驱动的自动会议录制，配置Google Cloud OAuth、连接日历、设置默认机器人和自动排期，并处理重复事件及会后工作流。

skills.name: getting-started
skills.description: First-time setup for MeetStream - guides a brand-new user through account signup, API key creation, environment configuration, and a validation ping. Auto-trigger when user says "set up MeetStream", "I don't have a MeetStream account", "first time using MeetStream", "MeetStream onboarding", "create MeetStream API key", "MeetStream signup", "how do I start with MeetStream", or when a user invokes any other MeetStream skill without MEETSTREAM_API_KEY set.

skills.name: migrate-from-recall

MeetStream is now essentially one-to-one with Recall (cheaper, plus native AI summaries and MIA voice agents). Use when the user says "migrate from Recall", "move off recall.ai", "switch from Recall to MeetStream", "port my Recall bot", "Recall alternative migration", or points you at a codebase that calls recall.ai. Offers an automated CLI path and a manual guided path.
headings: Path A - Automated (recommended for a whole codebase)
Verify against the live API afterward
Path B - Manual / guided (for a single file or a teaching walkthrough)
skills.description_zh: 将已有Recall.ai集成迁移至MeetStream，重写基础URL、端点、请求字段与Webhook处理，提供自动CLI和手动路径；原文称基本一对一且支持原生摘要及MIA语音智能体。

skills.name: notetaker
skills.description: Build a complete MeetStream-powered AI meeting notetaker - bot joins, records, transcribes, generates an AI summary, and emails it to the meeting attendees (you choose the email provider: Resend / SendGrid / SMTP). Use when the user says "build a notetaker", "AI meeting notetaker", "meeting recorder with AI summaries", "auto-summarize my meetings", "AI meeting summarizer", "meeting action items extractor", "meeting recap email", or any variant of a meeting-summary product. Walks through tech stack choice, scaffolds webhook handler, transcript fetch, LLM summary, and email delivery end-to-end.
